description: This file contains a final class `CombinatoricsUtils` with static utility methods for combinatorial computations such as binomial coefficients, factorials, Stirling numbers, and combination iterators.

classes.name: CombinatoricsUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for combinatorial calculations like binomial coefficients, factorials, Stirling numbers, and generating combinations.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Calculates the exact binomial coefficient (n choose k) as a long, with precondition checks and overflow handling, for values of n up to 66.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Calculates the binomial coefficient (n choose k) as a double, suitable for larger n, with checks for overflow into infinity.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the binomial coefficient (n choose k).

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Returns n! as a long, for n up to 20; throws exception if n is negative or too large.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Returns n! as a double, accurate for n up to 169 (since 170! exceeds Double.MAX_VALUE).

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of n!.

methods.name: stirlingS2
methods.description: Returns the Stirling number of the second kind S(n,k), with caching for small values.

methods.name: combinationsIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over all k-element subsets of {0,..,n-1}.

methods.name: checkBinomial
methods.description: Validates input parameters for binomial coefficient calculations.
